description: Look up OpenFEMA declarations by number, NOAA National Water Prediction Service stage and flow by gauge ID, National Weather Service alerts by county zone, USGS flood-impact thresholds by reference point ID, road restrictions from selected state and local publishers, or outage reports from participating utilities by county in California and Maryland or by ZIP in Maryland. Road results include official traveler links. Results carry availability and source dates where supplied. Confirm jobsite conditions separately. FEMA declarations do not establish reimbursement. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

zip.description: Maryland ZIP outage lookup. The count covers participating utilities and does not represent a county total.

zone.description: NWS county zone code such as IAC153.

number.description: FEMA disaster declaration number. Designated areas and program flags provide planning context. Verify applicant, work and cost eligibility separately.

pointId.description: USGS flood-impact reference point ID. Compares fresh measured gauge height with the published point threshold. This does not establish road access.

lat.description: Latitude rounded to two decimal places.

lon.description: Longitude rounded to two decimal places.

route.description: Numbered route such as I-80. Returns current user-reported, unverified observations.
Exact Ohio road name such as I-70. These are source references.

lat.description: Ohio-area latitude rounded to two decimals.

lon.description: Ohio-area longitude rounded to two decimals.

route.description: Optional exact published road name or supported interstate alias. Live work-zone lookup is available for selected providers.
Exact San Francisco street name, such as SUTTER ST. SFMTA permit windows require review.
Exact Denver street name, such as E 49TH AVE. Permit windows flag possible occupancy for review.
Exact Harrisburg street name, such as Verbeke Street. Closure windows require independent confirmation.

localUtilityReference.description: Optional manual outage map for the stated utility service area. It does not establish countywide conditions or jobsite power.
